external_relations.target_title: Purge use_specialist from every shipped surface before release

source.description:
PROBLEM
dist/types/tools/specialist/use_specialist.tool.d.ts and its .d.ts.map survive in the build
output after the source was deleted in #342, and both are packed (4.5kB + 504B, confirmed in
npm pack --dry-run). tsc does not remove orphaned declaration outputs, and the build has no
clean step for dist/types.

Inert: only dist/types/lib.d.ts is reachable through the exports map, so nothing can consume
it. It is dead weight that names a deleted tool, not a functional defect.

Deliberately left out of unitAI-fplre, which covered shipped PROSE. This is build-output
cleanliness and conflating the two would have blurred what the release-blocking fix was.

SUCCESS
The tarball carries no declaration files for deleted sources.

SCOPE
The build pipeline in package.json scripts, or a clean step for dist/types.

NON_GOALS
Do not hand-delete the two files and call it done — tsc will keep leaving orphans behind on
every future deletion. Fix the build or accept the drift knowingly.

CONSTRAINTS
dist/ is committed and CI diffs it against a fresh build, so any clean step must be
deterministic: it has to produce identical output on every machine or it turns every PR red.

VALIDATION
- Delete a source file, rebuild, confirm no orphan declaration remains.
- npm pack --dry-run lists no use_specialist artifacts.
- git diff --exit-code -- dist/ clean after a fresh build.

OUTPUT
A dist/types that reflects the current source tree.
